purpose: Freeze the protocol, data manifest, and result schema before any new waveform access. A hash mismatch after this point requires a new versioned protocol, never a silent continuation.
immutable_rules: These three files and their SHA-256 values are frozen. Any change requires a new protocol_id (e.g., mechanism-v2.6.1 or mechanism-v2.7).
No waveform value from D16, MORPHO, or COQTEL may be read before this receipt is produced and verified.
The capacity-aware terminal-hold pre-access test must pass before any result JSON is produced.
E7 and E8 remain immutable. D04/D24 remain discovery-only.
verification_command: powershell -Command "Get-FileHash protocols\mechanism_v2_6.json -Algorithm SHA256; Get-FileHash protocols\mechanism_v2_6_data_manifest.json -Algorithm SHA256; Get-FileHash protocols\mechanism_v2_6_result_schema.json -Algorithm SHA256"
